notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Brandywine Farmer.
You control a Food.
description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of Brandywine Farmer due to Infinite Reflection.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Repeat for infinite Food tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brandywine Farmer, adding one mana of any color.
When Brandywine Farmer dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 8.
